title: Langtang Lirung, Thursday

summary.what: North-face rock avalanche on Langtang Lirung, ice included, then a long runout.
killed: ice-only burst as the whole start
distant blasting ringing a mountain like a bridge

boundMoved.to: Why did that rock slab fail, taking ice with it?

boundEvent.whatHappened: North-face rock avalanche on Langtang Lirung, ice included, then a long runout. Shugar: a big bedrock failure that took part of the glacier with it. Cook: the rock collapsed; the glacier was cargo.
boundEvent.where: North face of Langtang Lirung, ~5,200 m, then Lendi/Lhende Khola
boundEvent.scale: Bedrock slab plus glacier cargo; long debris-flood runout
boundEvent.sequence: Bedrock under the glacier tongue failed. Ice went with the rock. Mass entered the steep valley. Debris flood ran out.
boundEvent.firstNounRisk: China or climate as one noun doing four chain jobs

settled: A north-face rock avalanche occurred on Langtang Lirung.
Ice was included; it was cargo, not the isolated start.
Mass entered Lendi/Lhende Khola and produced a debris flood.
River color green to brown is sediment load.
Villages and border works were buried downstream.
provisional: Bedrock under the glacier tongue failed at about 5,200 m.
Climate may have preconditioned permafrost glue. That is not the precise trigger.
Hydropower works sat in the runout.
open: Last increment on that slab (thaw, water in joints, something nobody has isolated).
Exactly who was in the path, and when.

causalChain.initiation: Bedrock under the glacier tongue failed on the north face (~5,200 m). Ice went with the rock. Glacier collapse as the whole initiation failed a hoop test.
causalChain.amplification: Mass into Lendi/Lhende Khola; steep narrow valley; ice melt plus sediment; debris flood. River color green to brown is sediment load.
causalChain.exposure: Villages and border works buried downstream. Hydropower works sat in the runout. That can explain deaths without explaining the scar.
causalChain.response: Not isolated in the Thursday packet beyond burial of works and villages.

hoopFailures.constraint: Energy / attenuation / location. Construction at the scar is not in the Cook/Shugar interviews.

hoopFailures.mechanismKilled: Ice-only burst as the whole start
hoopFailures.constraint: Geometry and materials: rock led; ice was cargo.

allowedHypotheses.claim: Last increment could be thaw or water in joints. Nobody has isolated it.

discriminatingTraces.lookFor: A measurement or observation that isolates the last increment on that slab, not a confirming anecdote.

remainder: The last increment on that slab is unknown. Climate may precondition; it is not isolated as the trigger. Water budget and who was in the path remain separate. Retired leftover: why did that ice detach?
